summary: On the 15.5 line, Next.js now refuses to run with TypeScript >= 7.0 and exits with an error (the 16.x line gained TypeScript 7 support instead).
`experimental.cachedNavigations` is on by default for apps with `cacheComponents: true`, so 'use cache' content is reused from the client cache across navigations unless set to `false`.

`unstable_catchError` from `next/error` is renamed to `catchError`, and the `unstable_retry` prop passed to `error.js`/`global-error.js` boundaries and `catchError` fallbacks is renamed to `retry`; no `unstable_` aliases remain.

Undocumented methods on the custom-server `next()` instance (`setAssetPrefix()`, `revalidate()`, logging helpers and the legacy `render*` helpers) are deprecated with warnings; use `getRequestHandler()`.
The Edge runtime (`export const runtime = 'edge'`) and the `preferredRegion` route segment config are deprecated with build warnings and `@deprecated` types; the Node.js runtime is the path forward.

Removed experimental config keys: `experimental.turbopackMemoryLimit` and `experimental.viewTransition` (view transitions work without a flag), and, merged here under the same-kind rule, keys whose feature is now always on or folded elsewhere: `experimental.rootParams` (`next/root-params` works without a flag), `experimental.turbopackImportTypeText` (`import ... with { type: 'text' }` on by default), `experimental.partialFallbacks` (now part of `partialPrefetching`), `experimental.instantNavigationDevToolsToggle` (Navigation Inspector shown whenever `cacheComponents` is on), `experimental.immutableAssetToken` (replaced by `supportsImmutableAssets` and an `_next/static/immutable/` path prefix) and `experimental.imgOptSkipMetadata`.

The instant segment config object changes shape: the required `prefetch: 'static' | 'runtime'` option is removed (prefetching is now set by the separate `export const prefetch` segment config), and `samples`/`from` become `unstable_samples`/`unstable_from`; `instant` also accepts `true`.

The reworked App Router scroll and focus handling (`experimental.appNewScrollHandler`) is on by default: after navigation the active element is blurred instead of focusing the first focusable element in the segment.

When `next dev` detects a coding agent (env vars such as `CLAUDECODE`), it now creates or updates a managed block in the project's `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` pointing at the bundled docs; opt out with `agentRules: false`.
The `opengraph-image` (and sibling image route) default export's return type is narrowed to `Response`; the other return types the types previously allowed failed the build.
`experimental.optimisticRouting` (client-side route prediction) is on by default, changing when navigations commit and which segments are fetched.
Requests to unknown paths whose `Sec-Fetch-Dest` is not a document (images, workers, manifest icons) now get a plain-text 404 instead of rendering the HTML not-found page.
`experimental.prefetchInlining` is on by default: small segment prefetches are bundled into one response per link instead of one request per segment.
`enablePrerenderSourceMaps` now defaults to `true` for every app (previously only when `cacheComponents` was on), so errors thrown while prerendering in `next build` are source-mapped.
Turbopack filesystem caching for `next build` (`experimental.turbopackFileSystemCacheForBuild`) is now on by default, so repeat builds reuse artifacts from `.next/cache`.
`experimental.turbopackTreeShaking` is renamed to `experimental.turbopackModuleFragments`.
`next build` type-checks with the project's TypeScript CLI by default (`experimental.useTypeScriptCli`, opt out with `false`) instead of the compiler API.
The `export const unstable_instant` route segment config is renamed to `instant` (stabilized); `unstable_instant` is no longer read.

`experimental.validateRSCRequestHeaders` is on by default: an RSC request whose headers do not match the client's cache-busting search parameter is no longer served as an RSC response (previously only validated when opted in).
`experimental.varyParams` is on by default: cached navigation/prefetch entries are keyed only on the params a segment actually reads instead of on all params.
The `experimental.appNewScrollHandler` config key is removed; the new scroll/focus handling (default since 16.3.0) can no longer be turned off.
Turbopack production builds now generate shorter CSS Module class names (development keeps the long readable names).
Pages Router support for React 18 is deprecated: `next dev`/`next build` warn when React 18 is installed, ahead of removal in 17.

Client-side-rendering bailouts (`useSearchParams` without Suspense, resumed-render and CSR bailouts) now use React's `ReactDOM.browser` mechanism by default instead of throwing the Next.js bailout errors.

`experimental.strictRouteMatching` is on by default: App Router URLs that cannot build a complete route tree are rejected, unreachable pages and incompatible parallel-route slots are reported, and interception routes need a canonical route; `deprecated.looseRouteMatching: true` is the escape hatch.
Turbopack production builds now mangle internal export names by default (`experimental.turbopackMangleExportNames`), shortening the names used to connect modules.
Turbopack now emits its runtime as one chunk shared across routes (`experimental.turbopackSharedRuntime` on by default) instead of a per-route runtime.
Unrecognized Server Action IDs now return 400 (malformed) or 409 (unknown in this deployment) for both fetch and MPA form submissions, instead of 404 or 500.
`useReportWebVitals` moves to web-vitals v6: the FID metric is no longer reported and CLS/INP/LCP are now also reported for soft navigations with a `navigationURL`.
